YEAR 2: SEMESTER 2 EXAMINATIONS

CERTIFICATE IN MIDWIFERY

Paper Code CM

December 2

Examiner's checklist

Key areas to assess Score Done Partially done Not done Total
1 Greets the patient and creates rapport ½ x
2 Explains procedure to patient and provides privacy ½ x
3 Confirms that she has an empty bladder 1
4 Places the woman in semi-recumbent position ½ x
5 Covers the mother from the hip downward with a sheet ½ x
6 Performs abdominal examination as follows:
  • • Moves to the foot of bed/couch and inspects abdomen for;
    • - Shape and symmetry
    • - Fetal movements
    • - Scars.
    • - Striae gravidarum.
    • - Linear nigra.
  • • Performs;
    • - Superficial palpation
    • - Measures fundal height.
    • - Determines fetal part at the uterine fundus.
    • - Palpates side of abdominal for the lie and position.
    • - Palpates above symphysis pubis for presenting part and assesses for engagement (fetal descent).
    • - Assesses for cephalic versus breach presentation.
    • - Places fetal scope appropriately to listen to fetal heart.

YEAR 2: SEMESTER 2: EXAMINATIONS

CERTIFICATE IN MIDWIFERY

Paper code: CM 224 OSPE

December 2020

Examiner's Checklist

Key areas to assessScoreDonePartially doneNot doneTotal
1Creates rapport and positions the mother.½
2Washes hands and puts on gloves.½
3Performs a vaginal examination to confirm extended arms.1
4Mentions the Lovset manouvre method to be used in the procedure involving rotation and downward traction.1
5Grasps the baby by the sacrum and rotates the baby through an angle of 180° with the back uppermost while applying a downward traction.2
6Delivers the arm which has come anterior first by flexing it.2
7Rotates the baby again and delivers the 2nd hand in the same way.2
8Leaves the baby to hang on its body.½
9Hands over the mother to the assistant to complete the delivery.½
TOTAL10
